facts.fact: The new GST rates took effect from 22 September 2025
facts.quote: The revised rates and exemptions will come into effect from 22nd September 2025

facts.fact: The changes were recommended by the 56th GST Council meeting on 3 September 2025
facts.quote: Recommendations of the 56th Meeting of the GST Council held at New Delhi, today Posted On: 03 SEP 2025

facts.fact: GST now has two main rates: 5% (merit rate) and 18% (standard rate)
facts.quote: a 2 rate structure with a Standard Rate of 18% and a Merit Rate of 5%; a special de-merit rate of 40% for a select few goods and services

facts.fact: There is a special de-merit rate of 40% for a few select goods and services
facts.quote: a 2 rate structure with a Standard Rate of 18% and a Merit Rate of 5%; a special de-merit rate of 40% for a select few goods and services

facts.fact: The 40% rate covers luxury and sin goods such as pan masala, tobacco, aerated drinks, high-end cars, yachts and private aircraft
facts.quote: a 40% on luxury and sin goods such as pan masala, tobacco, aerated drinks, high-end cars, yachts, and private aircraft ensures fairness and revenue balance

facts.fact: Admission to casinos and race clubs moved to 40%
facts.quote: (ii) Admission to casinos, race clubs, any place having casinos or race clubs, or sporting events like the IPL. 28% With ITC 40% with ITC

facts.fact: The earlier 12% and 28% slabs were removed
facts.quote: The shift to a two-slab system of 5% and 18%, removing the earlier 12% and 28% rates, will make taxation more transparent and easier to follow.
GST reforms cut taxes on household essentials (soaps, toothpaste, Indian breads) to 5% or Nil boosting affordability

facts.fact: Special rates continue for the goods in Schedules IV, V and VI (3%, 0.25% and 1.5%), such as precious metals
facts.quote: (iv) 3 per cent. in respect of goods specified in Schedule IV, (v) 0.25 per cent. in respect of goods specified in Schedule V, (vi) 1.50 per cent. in respect of goods specified in Schedule VI
facts.note: 'Such as precious metals' is not in the quote: the schedules' contents are in the same notification.

facts.fact: Pan masala, cigarettes and other tobacco products (including bidi) stayed at their old GST rates plus compensation cess after 22 September 2025, until the compensation cess loans were repaid (the new rates applied from 1 February 2026)
facts.quote: Pan Masala, gutkha, cigarettes, chewing tobacco products like zarda, unmanufactured tobacco and bidi will continue at the existing rates of GST and compensation cess where applicable, till loan and interest payment obligations under the compensation cess account are completely discharged.
facts.note: Derived: the end date comes from fact 11 (new rates from 1 February 2026); this quote gives only the condition.

facts.fact: From 1 February 2026, pan masala, tobacco products other than bidis, and cigarettes moved to 40%, and bidis to 18%
facts.quote: A revised rate structure has been notified with effect from February 1st, 2026, whereby bidi has been brought under the 18% GST rate, while pan masala, various forms of tobacco (other than bidis), cigarettes and nicotine-based inhalation products have been placed under the 40% GST rate.

facts.fact: From 1 February 2026 these products are valued on the declared retail sale price (RSP) and compensation cess on them was withdrawn
facts.quote: At the same time, a special valuation mechanism based on the declared retail sale price has been introduced for these products, and the levy of compensation cess on specified pan masala and tobacco products has been withdrawn.

facts.fact: PIB (09 Oct 2026) confirms the structure after the 57th Council meeting: two main rates of 5% and 18% and a special 40% rate
facts.quote: The new structure has two main rates , 5% and 18%, and a special 40% rate for select goods and services. This reform process has continued at the 57th meeting in October 2026.

facts.fact: The 57th GST Council meeting was held on 08.10.2026 (8 October 2026)
facts.quote: Posted On: 08 OCT 2026 7:03PM by PIB Delhi The 57 th Meeting of the GST Council was held today in New Delhi

summary: All GST 2.0 claims confirmed on PIB, the GST Council Dec 2025 newsletter (1 Feb 2026 tobacco change) and the IGST rate notification 9/2025 (precious-metal special rates).
